subject: Schedule: Technical walkthrough for your Redwood trial
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Connor <alex.connor@acme.dev>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-12T16:14:00Z
Subject: Schedule: Technical walkthrough for your Redwood trial

Hi Alex,

Thanks for signing up for a Redwood trial — welcome! I want to get you a short technical walkthrough so we can: confirm your integration plan, review a quick performance/cost baseline for your expected workload, and answer any product questions.

If it helps, I can run a focused 20-minute session for just the integration checklist, or a 40-minute walkthrough that includes a short Q&A and a brief performance tuning session. Pick whichever works best and I will queue an engineer:

- 20 min — quick integration + next steps
- 40 min — integration, perf baseline, and Q&A

Please pick a time that works for you here: https://calendly.com/redwood-trials/30min (if none of the slots fit, reply with preferred windows and timezone and we’ll find one).

I've attached a short trial checklist to help you prepare: redwood-trial-checklist.pdf (what to bring: sample prompt set, expected tokens/second, privacy/compliance notes).

Next steps after you pick a time: Monica (cc'd) will introduce the engineer who will run the walkthrough and share a short agenda.

Looking forward to it — and please reply if you have any constraints (timezones, sensitive datasets, or specific areas to cover).

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai

Hi Soojin,

Alex from Acme.dev booked the 40-minute walkthrough for Thu Jul 15 at 17:30 UTC (10:30 PT). He plans to run batch embeddings + a chat assistant (approx 150 tokens/turn, ~200 req/s peak). I attached the trial checklist Sofia sent and his quick note.

Can you lead the session? Suggested agenda (short):
- 5 min introductions + goals
- 10 min architecture review for embeddings pipeline
- 15 min live config + perf/quantization suggestions
- 10 min Q&A and next steps

If that works, please confirm and I’ll send the calendar invite with you as host. If you prefer a different split or need a pre-read, let me know — we can request the sample dataset Alex mentioned.

Thanks — Monica
